title: Luhn check and issuer ranges readable by name
task: Implement `card.Validate(number string) error` in package `card`: spaces are stripped, the result must be thirteen to nineteen digits, must pass the Luhn checksum, and must begin with a recognised issuer prefix (4 is Visa, 51 through 55 is Mastercard, 34 or 37 is Amex). Also `Issuer(number string) (string, error)`. A reader who has never heard of Luhn should be able to follow the checksum from the names alone.
